object_description: three-level compact hall building on a tall base with a sloping roof
design_condition: The building is placed as a striking element at the hilltop and aligned with the school complex, but its height creates a tight relationship with the kindergarten and weakly connects the lower forecourts and playground to the existing open-space structure.

positive.statement: The building fits into the orthogonally oriented school complex.

position.rationale: Top and elevation views show a compact orthogonally aligned building mass.

negative.statement: The building volume towers over the existing school complex and appears far too dominant overall.

position.rationale: Elevations clearly show the building's tall multi-storey volume and dominant roof height.

negative.statement: The forecourts and playground are only peripherally connected to the existing open-space structure.

position.rationale: The exterior sample provides only a low southern site-edge anchor for these open-space areas.

negative.statement: The western corner violates the program by extending the already expanded construction area.

position.rationale: The western directional constraint places the comment at the leftmost footprint corner.

negative.statement: The distance between the high south facade and the kindergarten is only around 7.5 metres.

position.rationale: South and top views constrain a high facade position along the southern building edge.

negative.statement: The macro-spatial competition with the church cannot be justified by a secular gymnasium.

position.rationale: The absent church is represented by a broad upper building anchor for the stated urban comparison.

negative.statement: The separation of work lessons and sports activities is only possible to a limited extent.

position.target: separation of work lessons and sports activities
position.rationale: Interior program separation is not distinguishable, so it receives an approximate mid-building surface anchor.

negative.statement: The workrooms share access and corridors with cloakrooms and sanitary facilities, creating significant potential for disruption.

position.rationale: The internal access relationship is absent from the exterior sample and mapped approximately to the lower volume.

negative.statement: The foyer cannot be closed off, so use independent of sports operations is not possible.

position.rationale: The foyer is not identifiable externally, so it is approximated near the lower southern building surface.

negative.statement: The multi-storey structure generates additional traffic areas and exceeds average building volume and total cost.

position.rationale: All elevations visibly corroborate the multi-storey mass and its extensive circulation volume.

negative.statement: The project is not convincing in terms of site planning, functional, and economic aspects.

position.rationale: The combined site-planning judgment is anchored broadly to the sampled building and surrounding site edge.
